name: pixelfx
text: Game devs, still paying for pixel effects? Pixel-F-X has 244 of them, free. Fire, lightning, magic, explosions, each one a small piece of code. Recolor them, mirror them, or export sprite sheets for Godot or Unity. And its Claude Code skill makes new ones like a picky pixel artist: draft, render, look, refine. Comment PIXELFX and I'll send you the link.

name: dimdraw
text: Your UI can now get Apple-style blueprints. Dimensional Drawing is a free skill for Claude Code. Point it at a card or a dialog. You get one technical sheet: paddings, gaps, corner radii and layers, all measured. It never invents values. Unknowns stay T-B-D. A second skill turns the sheet into a short film. Comment DRAWING and I'll send you the link.

name: tstack
text: Still babysitting your AI's pull requests? Theo's T-stack has nine free skills for Claude Code and Codex. Here are four. Council: three models from different providers review your change until they agree. Babysit: it watches a PR through CI and fixes the real findings. Take over: it finishes someone else's PR and keeps their credit. Full send: from change to merged PR, with nobody watching. Comment TSTACK and I'll send you the link.
